entries.name: SRE-Marathon
entries.construct_summary: Continuous long-horizon SRE operation with overlapping faults, persistent workspace, periodic agent invocation and offline deterministic scoring.

results.uncertainty_or_repeat_note: Paper reports 10 methods; do not treat methods as repeated independent trials.

scale.task_count_description: Three applications, approximately 60 faults per continuous run.

limitations: Best-of-ten method score is a benchmark-specific composite.
Paper describes correlation/localization more common than repair while faults remain active.
what_not_established: Generic production SRE safety.
Participant-side effect durability or customer/business correctness.
